body: Suresh (Indiranagar), Customer ke liye draft: “Office lunch plan kar rahe hain? Mylari South Indian Cafe par Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 listed hai. Bulk quote ke liye headcount, date, veg/Jain requirements aur delivery location bhejiye.” Quote se pehle capacity aur delivery charges check kijiye; listed offer ko bulk rate na maanein. Ek detail badalni ho toh bhejiye, ya draft theek ho toh APPROVE likhiye.
rationale: Existing planning intent gets actual proposed copy; package prices and capacity are not inferred from unrelated listing offers.

body: Padma (Mylapore), Proposed pilot: a 4-week kids yoga block, grouped by age, with a parent introduction and an instructor-confirmed capacity. Interest-check draft: “Zen Yoga Studio is exploring a kids yoga group. Send your child's age and preferred weekday timing; we will share the proposed schedule and fee.” Confirm the age band, instructor and fee before opening bookings. Reply with the one detail to change, or APPROVE to keep this draft.
rationale: Existing planning intent gets actual proposed copy; package prices and capacity are not inferred from unrelated listing offers.

body: Hi Aditya, Karim's Salon here. Your appointment is tomorrow. Reply CONFIRM if you can attend, or RESCHEDULE to check another time.
rationale: Next-day reminder sent on behalf of the merchant, with no invented time when the schedule is not supplied, and one two-way CTA.

body: Hi Riya, Beauty Lounge by Renu se. Kal aapki appointment hai. Aa sakte hain toh CONFIRM bhejiye, ya doosra time check karne ke liye RESCHEDULE likhiye.
rationale: Next-day reminder sent on behalf of the merchant, with no invented time when the schedule is not supplied, and one two-way CTA.

body: Ramesh, summer 2026 wala shift shuru ho chuka hai: ORS demand +40, sunscreen demand +38, antifungal demand +45, aur cold cough demand -60. Malviya Nagar mein yeh decide karta hai ki log pehle kya maangenge — discount nahi. Aapki listing pe pichhle 30 din mein 1,850 views, 38 calls aur 4.5% CTR hai, toh upar jo dikhta hai woh sach mein dekha jaata hai. Main agle chaar hafton ke liye ek page ki shelf aur counter priority list bana doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Concrete seasonal demand movements translated into an operator decision, anchored on the merchant's own visibility numbers.

body: Dr. Meera (Lajpat Nagar), ek session hai jiske liye time block karna banta hai — IDA Delhi: Digital impressions — 2026 state of the art, 2 May, 7pm ko, 2 CDE credits, members ke liye free. IDA Delhi chapter calendar ne list kiya hai. Main registration ke steps aur ek calendar block ek hi message mein bhej doon, taaki clinic hours mein miss na ho? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Time-bound professional opportunity with date, credits, fee and source, without inventing seat scarcity and a single scheduling action.

body: Namaste Mr. Sharma, Apollo Health Plus Pharmacy se. Aapki monthly medicines — metformin, atorvastatin, aur telmisartan — ka stock 28 Apr tak chalega. Aapka delivery address saved hai. REFILL bhejiye, hum ready rakh denge — ya prescription badla ho toh CHANGE likhiye.
rationale: Exact molecules and run-out date from the record, saved-delivery state, and a confirmation CTA that also catches prescription changes.

body: Hi Vivaan, Bright Smile Dental here. Checking whether you need a follow-up visit. Reply YES to check availability, or STOP to end reminders.
rationale: The refill label is inconsistent with a non-pharmacy merchant, so the message degrades to a safe follow-up reminder and names no medicine.

body: Dr. Meera, Smile Studio 8 Apr ko 1.3 km door khula hai, Dental Cleaning @ ₹199 ke saath. React karne se pehle: aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 2,410 views, 18 calls aur 2.1% CTR hai, aur Dental Cleaning @ ₹299 live hai. Price badalne se pehle included services aur apne costs compare kijiye. Main ek sharper listing comparison bana doon, aapki asli strength par? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Local competitive pressure answered with the merchant's own position, an explicit recommendation against a price war, and one specific ask.

body: Suresh, Indiranagar ke paas ek naya competitor khula hai. React karne se pehle: aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 12,400 views, 88 calls aur 3.2% CTR hai, aur Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149 live hai — yeh asli base hai, panic wali baat nahi. Bas ek cheez bataiye jo woh sabse zyada push kar rahe hain — price, timing, ya koi service jo aap list nahi karte — main aapki strength par listing ka jawaab draft kar dungi. Woh ek detail reply kijiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Local competitive pressure answered with the merchant's own position, an explicit recommendation against a price war, and one specific ask.

body: Lakshmi, ek operator sawaal — aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 4,980 views, 62 calls aur 4.8% CTR hai aur Haircut @ ₹99 live hai. Is hafte customers kaunsi service maang rahe hain jo aapki list mein nahi hai? Ek cheez reply kar dijiye, main usi din post draft bana dungi; aur kuch nahi chahiye.
rationale: Asks the merchant something only they know, priced at one word of effort, with the merchant's real numbers as the reason for asking.

body: Hi Rashmi, PowerHouse Fitness here. It has been about 8 weeks since your last visit. No pressure — breaks happen, and restarting is not starting over. Last time you were working on weight loss. Reply YES to check availability this week, or STOP and we will not message again.
rationale: No-shame win-back with the supplied gap and prior goal, a low-commitment entry offer, and an explicit permanent opt-out.

body: Hi Reyansh, Asha Dental Care here. It has been a while since your last visit. No pressure — a short check-up is usually all it takes to know where things stand. Reply YES to check availability this week, or STOP and we will not message again.
rationale: No-shame win-back with the supplied gap and prior goal, a low-commitment entry offer, and an explicit permanent opt-out.

body: Hi Reyansh, Daily Care Medicos se. Aapki last visit ko kaafi time ho gaya. Kisi product ki availability check karni hai? Naam bhejiye; prescription medicines ke liye valid prescription chahiye. Messages band karne ke liye STOP likhiye.
rationale: No-shame win-back with the supplied gap and prior goal, a low-commitment entry offer, and an explicit permanent opt-out.

body: Anjali, 38 din ho gaye humari baat ko, pichhli baat subscription expiry par hui thi. Abhi listing par pichhle 30 din mein 1,200 views, 8 calls aur 2.2% CTR hai. Dobara shuru karne ke liye ek kaam ki cheez hai listing par ek service+price offer, jaise Haircut @ ₹99. Main aaj hi review ke liye post copy draft kar doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Dormancy quantified with the exact gap and its measurable cost, narrowed to a single reversible action instead of a menu of options.

Dobara shuru karne ke liye ek kaam ki cheez hai listing par ek service+price offer, jaise Weekday Lunch Thali @ ₹149. Main aaj hi review ke liye post copy draft kar doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.

body: Lakshmi, Diwali 31 Oct ko hai — 188 din baaki hain. Abhi concept prepare kar sakte hain aur promotion ki date baad mein decide kar sakte hain. Abhi karne layak cheez: aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 4,980 views, 62 calls aur 4.8% CTR hai, aur Haircut @ ₹99 live hai — festive package isi par banega. Main ek service+price concept draft kar doon, Diwali se do hafte pehle review ke liye? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Correctly refuses to promote 6 months early, states why, and converts a low-urgency moment into concrete preparation anchored on real listing data.

body: Pooja, which upcoming occasion matters for your Koramangala customers? Your listing has 5,934 views, 65 calls and 4.2% CTR in the last 30 days. Send the occasion and date; I will draft one relevant post around your existing services.
rationale: Missing seasonal details are requested instead of inventing a festival or imminent deadline.

body: Vikas, Sunrise Medicos abhi tak Google par unverified hai. Unverified hote hue bhi listing par pichhle 30 din mein 720 views, 14 calls aur 4.1% CTR hai — yaani demand badge ke bina bhi aa rahi hai. Verify karne ke baad estimate: 30% zyada visibility, postcard or phone call se. Yeh estimate hai, pakka gain nahi; verification method aur timing Google decide karta hai. Main teen exact steps ek message mein bhej doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Quantified listing gap with the supplied uplift estimate and verification route, framed as a small effort against demand the merchant is already earning.

body: Suresh, DC vs MI — 26 Apr, 7:30pm. Match-day menu price check kijiye; record mein is match ke liye valid offer confirm nahi hai. Aapki listing par pichhle 30 din mein 2,200 views, 12 calls aur 2% CTR hai. Post mein menu, delivery area aur aapka confirmed order cutoff rakhein. Cutoff time bhejiye, uske hisaab se post draft kar dungi.
rationale: Uses the actual match date and checks weekday offer restrictions; requests only the missing operational cutoff.

body: Suresh, aap 145 reviews par hain — 150 se sirf 5 door. Completed visits ke baad honest feedback maangiye; review ke liye discount ya reward ki zarurat nahi. Main do line ka review request bana doon jo aapka GRO ya jo bill settle karta hai billing ke turant baad WhatsApp par bhej sake? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Exact distance to the milestone converted into a same-week, zero-budget action assigned to a specific person.

body: Mukesh, latest listing snapshot: pichhle 30 din mein 787 views, 5 calls aur 5.3% CTR; exact milestone specified nahi hai. Completed visits ke baad chhota, neutral review request feedback dena asaan bana sakta hai. Main do line ka review request bana doon jo aapka GRO ya jo bill settle karta hai billing ke turant baad WhatsApp par bhej sake? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: A visible performance mark used as the reason to ask for reviews this week, with the ask handed to a named person and no budget attached.

body: Dr. Bharat, calls pichhle 7 din mein down 50% hue hain. Abhi — pichhle 30 din mein 980 views, 4 calls aur 1.8% CTR. Ek practical agla step: profile ko call-first banana — ek treatment, ek price, aur ek line ki pehli visit mein hota kya hai. Main aapke current numbers se woh draft kar doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Names the exact weak metric with its real value, separates seasonality from decline, and offers one category-correct recovery action.

body: Sushma, dikkat calls mein hai, interest mein nahi — 2,547 logon ne listing dekhi aur 22 ne call kiya — yaani har 100 views pe 0.9 call. Ek practical agla step: ek service+price post, aur Haircut @ ₹99 sabse tez wapas saamne laane wali cheez hai. Main aapke current numbers se woh draft kar doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Names the exact weak metric with its real value, separates seasonality from decline, and offers one category-correct recovery action.

body: Padma, calls moved up 15% over the last 7 days, most likely from kids yoga post. Right now — 880 views, 18 calls and 6.2% CTR in the last 30 days. Use this rise to test a follow-up post, then compare calls over the next seven days before deciding whether to repeat it. Want me to draft that follow-up post around First Month @ ₹499? Reply YES, or STOP.
rationale: Positive movement stated with its real magnitude, a measurable follow-up experiment, and one repeatable next post.

body: Vikas, calls pichhle 7 din mein 5% upar gaye hain. Abhi — pichhle 30 din mein 720 views, 14 calls aur 4.1% CTR. Is rise par ek follow-up post test kijiye, phir agle saat din calls compare karke decide kijiye ki repeat karna hai ya nahi. Main Free Home Delivery > ₹499 ke around woh follow-up post draft kar doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Positive movement stated with its real magnitude, a measurable follow-up experiment, and one repeatable next post.

body: Hi Priya, Dr. Meera's Dental Clinic se. Aapka 6 month cleaning due hai 12 Nov ko; last visit 12 May thi. Listed availability: 5 Nov, 6pm ya 6 Nov, 5pm. Preferred time reply kijiye; clinic booking confirm karega.
rationale: Recall built entirely on the supplied service, dates and open slots, in the customer's stated language, with an easy opt-out.

body: Hi Diya, Zen Yoga Studio here. Your next check-in is due. Reply YES and we will send you this week's open slots, or STOP if you would rather not be reminded.
rationale: Recall built entirely on the supplied service, dates and open slots, in the customer's stated language, with an easy opt-out.

body: Dr. Meera, Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04 se ek compliance update: Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Digital RVG sensors unaffected. Yeh 15 Dec se effective hai. Audit your X-ray setup before Dec 15; document E-speed or RVG in your SOPs. Aapki Lajpat Nagar practice mein equipment check aur front-desk explanation consistent rakhein. Main team ke liye audit checklist bana doon? YES bhejiye, ya STOP.
rationale: Source-cited regulation with the exact effective date, connected to the merchant's own listing traffic, resolved by one compliance artifact.
